# Adding New Video Sections

You can add new sections very easily.  

1. Copy the **second section (10-second video)**, including:  
   - the **subgraph** and **Get nodes**  
   - the **LoRA High node**  
   - the **LoRA Low node**  
   
2. Paste it **next to section 2**.

3. Connect the **extented image output** to the **source image input 1** and **output** to the **prev_ samples input** of the new section.

> Tip: Make sure all node connections are intact to avoid missing input errors.

Don't skip sections, do them in order: 1, then 2, then 3. If you go from section 1 straight to section 3, there will be a cut.

> ⚠️ **Important Quality Warning**  
> The longer the video is extended, the more the overall quality may gradually degrade over time.  
> This is expected behavior when chaining multiple video generations.

In my opinion, 30 seconds max with high resolution.
---

# Usage Tips (Longer Videos)

If you want to create videos longer than 5 seconds:

First, generate the first video.

If you don’t like the result, simply change the seed and generate again.

If you like the video, enable the second video.  
The seed remains the same.  
The first video will not be generated again.  
Only the second video will be generated.

Repeat the same process for the following videos.

### Additional Tip
If the workflow appears empty or no nodes are visible (this can happen when opening subgraphs):  
Click **Fit View** in the Canvas menu.  
If the Canvas is not visible, enable it here:  
`Settings → Canvas → Lite Graph → Show Graph Canvas`
To open a subgraph, click on the small icon in the top-left corner of the subgraph node.

widgets_values:
You can use **dynamic prompts** to have better control and this helps to make the video more dynamic. You just need to give this example prompt to a LLM like ChatGPT. It will be enough for it to describe the image you have and what you want as a video while keeping the same structure of the prompt in the following example.  

This will be a NSFW prompt; ChatGPT will not accept it. You can use **GLM 4.6V** You can use **GROK** [https://grok.com](https://grok.com)
, it can make NSFW prompt modifications.  

For more examples of prompts with different poses, you can check: [Enhanced FP8 Model](https://civitai.com/models/2053259?modelVersionId=2477539). Give these prompts to GLM with the dynamic prompt structure if you want.  

---

### Example 1

(At 0 seconds: Wide shot showing a slightly overweight man casually walking down a city street, camera fixed in front, urban environment with buildings and cars.)  
(At 1 second: Suddenly, a massive shark bursts from the pavement ahead, looking terrifying at first, pavement cracking, dust and debris flying, camera from side angle.)  
(At 2 seconds: Medium shot from the side, the man stumbles backward in shock, while the shark dramatically slows down and strikes a comically exaggerated sexy pose, revealing large, exaggerated shark breasts, covered by a colorful bikini.)  
(At 3 seconds: Close-up on the man’s face, eyes wide in disbelief, as he turns to look at the shark, small cartoon-style hearts floating above his head to emphasize his amazement, camera slightly low-angle.)  
(At 4 seconds: Dynamic travelling shot showing the man frozen in the street, the shark maintaining its sexy pose, water splashes and debris still moving realistically, urban chaos around.)  
(At 5 seconds: Wide cinematic shot pulling back, showing the man standing in the street, staring at the bikini-wearing shark with hearts above his head, epic perspective highlighting absurdity and humor.)

---

### Example 2 – Anime NSFW

(At 0 seconds: The couple in a cozy bedroom, anime style, soft lighting highlighting their intimate embrace, her back arched slightly as he positions himself.)  
(At 1 second: The man’s hips moving rhythmically, the head of his penis sliding effortlessly into her vagina, her body responding with a gentle, fluid motion, anime-style motion lines emphasizing the smooth penetration.)

(At 5 seconds: The couple locked in a passionate embrace, the scene exuding vibrant, seductive energy, anime style with smooth lines and soft shadows.)

- **High LoRA**:  
  [lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank128_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/blob/709844db75d2e15582cf204e9a0b5e12b23a35dd/Lightx2v/lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank128_bf16.safetensors)

  **Weight → 1.4**

---

# Combo 2 (Lightning) – Less Image Degradation

- **High LoRA**:  
  [wan2.2_i2v_A14b_high_noise_scaled_fp8_e4m3_lightx2v_4step_comfyui_1030.safetensors](https://civitai.com/models/1585622/lightning-lora-massive-speed-up-for-wan21-wan22-made-by-lightx2v-kijai)  
  **OR**  
  [Wan_2_2_I2V_A14B_HIGH_lightx2v_MoE_distill_lora_rank_64_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/blob/main/LoRAs/Wan22_Lightx2v/Wan_2_2_I2V_A14B_HIGH_lightx2v_MoE_distill_lora_rank_64_bf16.safetensors)  
  **Weight → 1**

- **Low LoRA**:  
  [wan2.2_i2v_A14b_low_noise_lora_rank64_lightx2v_4step_1017.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Wan2.2-Distill-Loras/blob/main/wan2.2_t2v_A14b_low_noise_lora_rank64_lightx2v_4step_1217.safetensors)  
  **Weight → 1**

---

# Combo 3 (Lightning) – Balanced Motion / Moderate Degradation

- **High LoRA**:  
  [lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank128_bf16.safetensors](https://civitai.com/models/1585622/lightning-lora-massive-speed-up-for-wan21-wan22-made-by-lightx2v-kijai)  
  **Weight → 3**

- **Low LoRA**:  
  [lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank128_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/blob/709844db75d2e15582cf204e9a0b5e12b23a35dd/Lightx2v/lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank128_bf16.safetensors)  
  **Weight → 1.5**

---

You don't have to use these Lightning LoRA combos. You can use other Lightning LoRAs instead.  
You can also disable the global Lightning LoRAs and assign, for example, **Combo 1 for Video 1**, **Combo 3 for Video 2**, and **Combo 2 for Video 3**.  
Each combo produces different motion and degradation behavior, which can help you fine-tune the final result.

The video quality will degrade even less if you don't use Lightning LoRAs, but it will take a very long time.
